source.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
source.text: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. It also sticks to safety policies more consistently. The article OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably appeared first on The Decoder .
